instruction: Cinematic film still, medium close-up. Inside a vintage camper van with a wooden ceiling and blue curtains, two brides are sitting closely. On the left foreground, the blonde woman in a beaded white wedding dress (R1) leans forward, looking down with a soft expression. Behind her on the right, the brunette woman in a ruffled white wedding dress (R2) sits upright, looking off-camera to the right, her shoulder brushing against the blonde woman (R1). Warm, soft interior lighting contrasts with cool blue tones from the window.
elements: R1 leans forward and looks down while seated close to R2
R2 sits upright behind R1 with her shoulder brushing R1
R1 is the forward foreground bride while R2 is the upright bride in shoulder contact behind her
R1 and R2 sit closely with R2 positioned behind R1 in a shoulder-brushing configuration
